//: Provenance + pin for the vendored OpenAPI contract(s). `pnpm fetch:openapi` downloads these release assets from the ottochain GitHub release into openapi/; then `pnpm gen:openapi` regenerates src/generated/openapi.ts. Set `release` to a tag (e.g. "v0.7.17") to pin a specific published contract, or "latest". Keys of `assets` are the release asset names; values are the local vendored filenames. The DL1 contract (openapi-dl1.json) is also published by ottochain and can be added here when the SDK needs DL1 types.
